ctx.x: Then, I found it different between there and here. I know that's how Coleman Hawkins and Louis Armstrong actually had to make themselves big. They went and stayed about 10 or 12 years, you know, before they actually got a big name, and then came back.

But that kind of reception, everything that I've read all the way back. I mean all the way back that James Reese Europe went over and Sidney Bechet (inaudible) you know. Ernest Ansermet And his writings, you know, relate to that whole kind of thing there. That's something that I guess that we don't get a chance to get around.
And the fact is, as Dud was saying, you know when he came back, they turn out in Japan by the stadium load. You know, just the same way that they come to a baseball game here
